text:
ryan (eng-platform): quick idea: add a compact "cost provenance" toggle on the Cost dashboard card. default collapsed shows one-line: tokens · cache est. · sku · reason. expand reveals CSV/download. thoughts?

claire (product): yes. customers want a short answer first, then a button for "Show me why". keep the one-liner non-monetary by default. :+1:

anil (eng-telemetry): we can emit a tiny precomputed blob per-route/day: {token_burn, tokens_saved_est, sample_rate, sku, routing_reason}. derived flag if sample_rate < 100%. small enough to bundle with dashboard payload.

marie (billing): include primary_tag and derived_flag in the CSV. also add canary_percent if rollout active so finance can separate experiment cost.

kate (design): UI note: use microcopy "estimated" next to cache numbers when derived. show a yellow dot + "low confidence" when sample_rate < 5%. keep the one-liner to one row only.

ryan (eng-platform): implementation plan: 1) nightly precompute job to write daily shards. 2) API: /v1/costs/summary returns compact blob with dashboard. 3) UI: toggle + expand modal + CSV link. 4) docs: short explainer and math appendix.

anil (eng-telemetry): sample precompute SQL (very rough):
```sql
select tenant_id, route_id, sku, date_trunc('day', ts) as day,
  sum(token_count) as token_burn,
  sum(case when cache_hit then token_count end) * (1/sample_rate) as tokens_saved_est,
  avg(sample_rate) as sample_rate
from request_samples
where ts >= now() - interval '1 day'
group by tenant_id, route_id, sku, day;
```

marie (billing): for billing exports: provide both sku_aggregate_daily and route_aggregate_daily. include a column "reason" in [normal, quota_reroute, fallback, manual_override].

kate (design): I'll sketch 2 variants: inline one-liner + expanded modal. will attach Figma.

deploy-bot: job queued -> cost-provenance-precompute v0.1 -> staging. initiated by @ryan. :rocket:

ryan (eng-platform): timeline: API PR this week, precompute job in staging next, UI mock + small canary after QA. ping me with tenant examples to validate.

claire (product): adding tenant-sample list: tenant-sunrise, tenant-orion. both have shared prefetch.

ryan (eng-platform): thanks — I'll open the RFC and link this thread.
